description: This is a PHP source file implementing the login page for the TestLink project. It handles configuration checking, user authentication via form or OAuth, session management, and rendering the login interface with security and customization features.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and normalizes the arguments received from the login request, determining the action to take (e.g., login, oauth, ajax check).

methods.name: validateOauth
methods.description: Validates the OAuth provider name against configured OAuth servers to prevent invalid OAuth services from being used.

methods.name: init_gui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI configuration object with security notes, OAuth buttons, background image, and other login screen settings based on configuration and session state.

methods.name: doBlockingChecks
methods.description: Performs schema version checks and other validation to prevent login if the database schema is incompatible or outdated.

methods.name: renderLoginScreen
methods.description: Uses Smarty templating engine to display the login screen to the user with the specified GUI parameters.

methods.name: authorizePostProcessing
methods.description: Handles post-login authorization processing, including redirecting on success or returning JSON response for AJAX login.

methods.name: processAjaxCheck
methods.description: Returns a JSON object indicating whether the current session is valid and providing localized labels for login prompts.

methods.name: cleanInput
methods.description: Sanitizes user input to prevent injection of scripts or HTML tags before storing or using it.
